summary: TSMC filed a routine Form 6-K reporting unaudited August 2026 consolidated revenue and monthly status of related-party lending, endorsements/guarantees and derivative transactions. August net revenue was NT$514.81 billion, up 10.1% month-over-month and 53.3% year-over-year; January-August revenue totaled NT$3,386.87 billion, up 39.3% versus 2025. The filing also discloses lending to TSMC Washington, guarantees for TSMC North America, Global and Arizona, and forward derivative positions. No special-situation event, transaction, board recommendation or advisor is present; routine operational disclosure only.
